card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

mechanism: A secures one rainy-day bicycle exception and turns it into written evidence to use with the next staff member.
confusable: Unlike asking only for immediate mercy, A must preserve the exception as a reusable precedent.
comparison: A counter handover motivates a note, while the form scene turns a one-day extension into a tested policy idea.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
